title: sla.create
description: This method allows to create new SLA objects.

period.description: Reporting period of the SLA. Possible values: 0 - daily; 1 - weekly; 2 - monthly; 3 - quarterly; 4 - annually.

slo.description: Minimum acceptable Service Level Objective expressed as a percent. If the Service Level Indicator (SLI) drops lower, the SLA is considered to be in problem/unfulfilled state. Possible values: 0-100 (up to 4 fractional digits).

effective_date.description: Effective date of the SLA. Possible values: date timestamp in UTC.

timezone.description: Reporting time zone, for example: Europe/London, UTC. For the full list of supported time zones please refer to PHP documentation.

status.description: Status of the SLA. Possible values: 0 - (default) disabled SLA; 1 - enabled SLA.

operator.description: SLA service tag operator. Possible values: 0 - (default) equals; 2 - contains.

service_tags.description: SLA service tags to be created for the SLA. At least one service tag must be specified.

period_from.description: Starting time of the recurrent weekly period of time (inclusive). Possible values: number of seconds (counting from Sunday).

period_to.description: Ending time of the recurrent weekly period of time (exclusive). Possible values: number of seconds (counting from Sunday).

schedule.description: SLA schedule to be created for the SLA. Specifying an empty parameter will be interpreted as a 24x7 schedule. Default: 24x7 schedule.

period_from.description: Starting time of the excluded downtime (inclusive). Possible values: timestamp.

period_to.description: Ending time of the excluded downtime (exclusive). Possible values: timestamp.

excluded_downtimes.description: SLA excluded downtimes to be created for the SLA.
